title: Explore large language models on Apple silicon with MLX
description: Discover MLX LM – designed specifically to make working with large language models simple and efficient on Apple silicon. We’ll cover how to fine-tune and run inference on state-of-the-art large language models on your Mac, and how to seamlessly integrate them into Swift-based applications and projects.

codeSnippets.title: Running DeepSeek AI's model with MLX LM
Text generation with MLX LM
codeSnippets.code:
mlx_lm.generate --model "mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit" \
                --prompt "Write a quick sort in Swift"

codeSnippets.title: Changing the model's behavior with flags
codeSnippets.code:
mlx_lm.generate --model "mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit" \
                --prompt "Write a quick sort in Swift" \
                --top-p 0.5 \
                --temp 0.2 \
                --max-tokens 1024

codeSnippets.title: MLX LM Python API
codeSnippets.code:
# Using MLX LM from Python

from mlx_lm import load, generate

# Load the model and tokenizer directly from HF
model, tokenizer = load("mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit")

# Prepare the prompt for the model
prompt = "Write a quick sort in Swift"
messages = [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
    messages, add_generation_prompt=True
)

# Generate the text
text = generate(model, tokenizer, prompt=prompt, verbose=True)

codeSnippets.title: Inspecting model architecture

from mlx_lm import load, generate

model, tokenizer = load("mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit")

print(model)

codeSnippets.title: Generation with KV cache
codeSnippets.code:
from mlx_lm import load, generate
from mlx_lm.models.cache import make_prompt_cache

# Load the model and tokenizer directly from HF
model, tokenizer = load("mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit")

# Prepare the prompt for the model
prompt = "Write a quick sort in Swift"
messages = [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
    messages, add_generation_prompt=True
)

cache = make_prompt_cache(model)

# Generate the text
text = generate(model, tokenizer, prompt=prompt, prompt_cache=cache, verbose=True)

codeSnippets.title: Model quantization with MLX LM in Python
Prompting before fine-tuning
codeSnippets.code:
mlx_lm.generate --model "./mistral-7b-v0.3-4bit" \
    --prompt "Who won the latest super bowl?"

codeSnippets.title: Prompting after fine-tuning
codeSnippets.code:
mlx_lm.generate --model "mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit" \
                --prompt "Who won the latest super bowl?" \
                --adapter "adapters"

codeSnippets.title: Fusing models
codeSnippets.code:
mlx_lm.fuse --model "mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit"
            --adapter-path "path/to/trained/adapters" \
            --save-path "fused-mistral-7b-v0.3-4bit" \
            --upload-repo "my-name/fused-mistral-7b-v0.3-4bit"

# Fusing our fine-tuned model adapters
mlx_lm.fuse --model "./mistral-7b-v0.3-4bit" \
            --adapter-path "adapters" \
            --save-path "fused-mistral-7b-v0.3-4bit"
